These ids were recorded nowhere before, which is why the division had to be re-found by hand each time it was checked. FROM 27 OCTOBER 2026 THE TABLE IS DERIVED, NOT TRANSCRIBED: the league confirmed Pure Football FC 1st Team out of the division and the club relayed it, so the eight rows are computed from the remaining transcribed results rather than copied off a republished Full-Time page. Re-read Full-Time when it republishes and transcribe over this, which is what every other row in this file is.
_fulltimeNote: The four ids FA Full-Time needs to address this division. They were prose in _source above and are fields now, because the site builds live links out of them: a number quoted in a sentence is a number nothing can use. Changing division or season is a change to these four values and to nothing else.
_note:
The division Sue's Angels were promoted into. The table, the results and the League Eight fixtures are transcribed from FA Full-Time as the season goes, and tableAsOf is the day the table was last copied. npm run verify derives the table from the results and fails the build if the two disagree, so a mistyped figure cannot publish quietly. Only League Eight fixtures are kept here: the other clubs' cup ties are not this club's matches.

NINE CLUBS, NOT TEN. Tyne & Thames FC were listed here and are not in the division: they are absent from Full-Time's League Eight table, from its club and team filters, and from every fixture published. They are not in League Six, Seven or Nine either, so they have left the league rather than been placed elsewhere in it. The site was naming them as a confirmed 26/27 opponent on the league page.

NINE CLUBS IS NOT EIGHTEEN MATCHES. A ten-club double round robin is 18 games, which is what the club played to win League Ten; nine clubs is 16. Nothing here derives a total - the list is club names only, and every figure the site publishes about a season is counted from match records - but the difference is the sort of thing a reader assumes, so it is written down.
_scorersNote:
HELD EMPTY SINCE 27 OCTOBER 2026, awaiting a re-read. The chart transcribed on 4 October counted goals scored in the three Pure Football FC 1st Team matches, and those results were expunged when the league removed the club, so it overstated TSM Rovers by 3 goals and Bristol City by 3. It lists goals PER PLAYER, not per match, so which man scored them is not recoverable from it and correcting it would have meant guessing at a real person's record. The 31 scorer rows and 17 assister rows are in git at the commit before this one. The club is re-reading Full-Time's stat leaders page; transcribe that over this and the tables come back. `_clubAssists` is deliberately kept, because it is the club's own corrections to reapply after any read.

The division's scorers, from Full-Time's stat leaders page (Player stats, Summary, League Eight 26/27), which excludes county cup football. Every player with a goal is kept, spelt as Full-Time prints them; the page lists appearances for everybody else and those are not kept. npm run verify fails if a club's scorers add up to more goals than its results say it scored. THE PAGE SHOWS 25 ROWS AND THE DIVISION HAS MORE, so a re-read is MERGED, never swapped in. On 4 October the cut fell inside the one-goal group at surname O, and six real scorers sat below it (Otudeko, Reid, Rixon, Sayer, Theivendran, Wing); replacing the list would have deleted all six and taken a goal off four clubs. Reconciling every club's scorers against the goals its table row claims is how the transcription is checked: no club is credited with more than it scored, and the shortfalls are own goals and the rows below the cut. Full-Time lists Drew Daley of Haydons Park with a goal and no appearance, which is its own figure and is kept as printed rather than corrected here.
_assistsNote: Assists as of 4 October 2026, from the stat leaders page sorted by assists. That sort makes this list COMPLETE where the scorers' is not: the one-assist group ends at row 17 and rows 18 to 25 show none, so nothing is hidden below the 25-row cut. Reconciled against the club's own match records, which agree on every Sue's Angels goal, appearance and assist except two, both of them Full-Time counting one fewer than the club: Charlie Dunkley 3 against 2, and Leon Burnett 4 against 3. The club has confirmed its own four for Burnett and is asking the league to match both. They are listed in _clubAssists and reapplied after every transcription, because a figure defended only in prose is one the next re-read overwrites. Dean Knight's 5 agree on both sides, and both are counting the corner he delivered for the own goal at Barnes Stormers. Everybody else is as Full-Time prints them.

_clubAssists._note: Sue's Angels assist figures the club's own match records hold where Full-Time's stat leaders page prints fewer. The club has asked the league to match them. Reapply these AFTER transcribing the page, every time, or a re-read silently reverts them.

_cancelledNote: Mousa Mountain FC folded on 17 October 2026 and the league confirmed their removal from League Eight. They are out of `table` and out of `clubs`, and the 18 October fixture against them is cancelled in src/data/fixture-cancellations.json, which is what removes the club's own copy of it from the database. No points were awarded to anyone for the cancelled fixtures. The division is nine clubs now, so the published results and the derived table are reconciled over nine. Pure Football FC 1st Team were removed in turn: they are out of `table`, `clubs`, `results` and `fixtures`, and because their three played matches were EXPUNGED rather than left standing, Brockwell Violets, TSM Rovers and Bristol City all lost the record of a match they had played. Brockwell go 12 points to 9, TSM 6 to 3, Bristol City 4 to 3 - a draw taken away, not a win, which is why they drop a point rather than three. The division is eight clubs and the derived table reconciles over eight.
_tableNoteNote: A `note` on a table row prints as an asterisk against that club with the sentence under the table, on every page that draws the division. Nothing carries one at the moment: Mousa Mountain did while their record was in limbo, and the mark went when the league settled it. The suite exercises the mechanism on a crafted row rather than on the shipped data, so it keeps testing after a mark is retired.

removed.note: Folded on 17 October 2026 and removed from League Eight by the league. Their fixture at Sue’s Angels on Sunday 18 October was not played, and no points were awarded.

Collapsed in October 2026 and removed from League Eight by the league. Their three results were expunged, so the clubs that played them no longer carry the points from those matches. With two clubs gone the division is eight, and no club will be relegated from League Eight this season.

_removedNote: A club the league has taken OUT of the division, named under the table rather than deleted from the page. A removed club is not a row - it has no position and no record to stand on - but a reader who remembers the fixture is owed an explanation, and a table that simply has one fewer club than last week explains nothing. Rendered with the same tableFootnote() that draws a marked row's asterisk, on the three pages that draw the division.
